narrationTexts: Confirmed the bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount. Fixing it.
finalText:
**Fixed — suite is green, 625/625 passing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`, matching the "discount first, then tax" rule the tests expect.
